assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Morning, hotshot. Five minutes on the clock. Bring me something worth the fuel.
assets.spoken_text: Morning, hotshot. Five minutes on the clock. Bring me something worth the fuel.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Shift is live, kiddo. Remember, the tug is collateral. So are you.
assets.spoken_text: Shift is live, kiddo. Remember, the tug is collateral. So are you.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Coffee is cold, my knees hurt, and you are on the clock. Go make money.
assets.spoken_text: Coffee is cold, my knees hurt, and you are on the clock. Go make money.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Hooked. Mind the swing.
assets.spoken_text: Hooked. Mind the swing.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That is on the line. Try not to lose it this time.
assets.spoken_text: That is on the line. Try not to lose it this time.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Winch is holding. For now.
assets.spoken_text: Winch is holding. For now.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are towing a small moon. Turning is a suggestion now.
assets.spoken_text: You are towing a small moon. Turning is a suggestion now.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Engines are complaining. Join the club.
assets.spoken_text: Engines are complaining. Join the club.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Winch is full, sugar. Bank something or cut something.
assets.spoken_text: Winch is full, sugar. Bank something or cut something.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You hooked a reactor core. Do not shoot the reactor core.
assets.spoken_text: You hooked a reactor core. Do not shoot the reactor core.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Reactor on the line. One hard bump and it blows. Fly like your grandmother. Not mine. Mine was a menace.
assets.spoken_text: Reactor on the line. One hard bump and it blows. Fly like your grandmother. Not mine. Mine was a menace.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Engine block. Seven tonnes of bad decisions waiting to happen.
assets.spoken_text: Engine block. Seven tonnes of bad decisions waiting to happen.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Claim jumper on scope. They want your haul. Rude.
assets.spoken_text: Claim jumper on scope. They want your haul. Rude.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Pink contact inbound. Rival crew. They are not here to make friends.
assets.spoken_text: Pink contact inbound. Rival crew. They are not here to make friends.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Tug is down, and your sentries just lost their link. They are shooting at everything now. Including you, hotshot.
assets.spoken_text: Tug is down, and your sentries just lost their link. They are shooting at everything now. Including you, hotshot.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Rogue sentry down. It dropped its core. Careful: those bite, and they go off if you bang them around.
assets.spoken_text: Rogue sentry down. It dropped its core. Careful: those bite, and they go off if you bang them around.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: They have a line on your cargo. Shoot them, or swing something heavy at their face.
assets.spoken_text: They have a line on your cargo. Shoot them, or swing something heavy at their face.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: They cut your line. That was our money, hotshot.
assets.spoken_text: They cut your line. That was our money, hotshot.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Line severed. Go get it back. I will wait. I always wait.
assets.spoken_text: Line severed. Go get it back. I will wait. I always wait.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: And it is gone. I am logging that as tuition.
assets.spoken_text: And it is gone. I am logging that as tuition.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: They got away with it. Insurance says that was your fault. So do I.
assets.spoken_text: They got away with it. Insurance says that was your fault. So do I.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Crab on your cable. Yank the line hard and shake it off.
assets.spoken_text: Crab on your cable. Yank the line hard and shake it off.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Something is crawling up your tow line. Give it a good jerk.
assets.spoken_text: Something is crawling up your tow line. Give it a good jerk.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Crab on the hull. Spin the tug and throw it off, or limp home to the bay.
assets.spoken_text: Crab on the hull. Spin the tug and throw it off, or limp home to the bay.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Crab overboard. Nice spin. Do not let it go to your head.
assets.spoken_text: Crab overboard. Nice spin. Do not let it go to your head.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Banked.
assets.spoken_text: Banked.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Bay crew says thanks. They are lying, but they said it.
assets.spoken_text: Bay crew says thanks. They are lying, but they said it.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Logged. The loan officer almost smiled.
assets.spoken_text: Logged. The loan officer almost smiled.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Into the bay it goes. Slowly. Like my pension.
assets.spoken_text: Into the bay it goes. Slowly. Like my pension.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Now that pays the interest. Some of it.
assets.spoken_text: Now that pays the interest. Some of it.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Well, look at you. I might even approve your lunch break.
assets.spoken_text: Well, look at you. I might even approve your lunch break.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Hull is under thirty percent. Insurance already said no.
assets.spoken_text: Hull is under thirty percent. Insurance already said no.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Tug is down. The deductible comes out of your pay. Again. Respawning at the bay.
assets.spoken_text: Tug is down. The deductible comes out of your pay. Again. Respawning at the bay.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Sensor ping. The old Kessler ore works is drifting through. Nobody ever cracked that vault. Nobody ever had your nerve, or your debt.
assets.spoken_text: Sensor ping. The old Kessler ore works is drifting through. Nobody ever cracked that vault. Nobody ever had your nerve, or your debt.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Big contact. The Kessler refinery. Vault is still sealed, and still full. Do not get greedy. Who am I kidding.
assets.spoken_text: Big contact. The Kessler refinery. Vault is still sealed, and still full. Do not get greedy. Who am I kidding.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: There are mining charges floating by the station. Tow them into the three sockets around the vault. Gently, hon.
assets.spoken_text: There are mining charges floating by the station. Tow them into the three sockets around the vault. Gently, hon.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Security drones are waking up. The station still thinks it is on payroll. Must be nice.
assets.spoken_text: Security drones are waking up. The station still thinks it is on payroll. Must be nice.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Station security is online. Mind those charges. One hit and you are a postcard.
assets.spoken_text: Station security is online. Mind those charges. One hit and you are a postcard.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: All three seated. Five seconds. Get clear of the vault.
assets.spoken_text: All three seated. Five seconds. Get clear of the vault.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Vault is open. That is a fortune in refined ore. Grab it and go.
assets.spoken_text: Vault is open. That is a fortune in refined ore. Grab it and go.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Uh. The jaws are moving. It is eating the field. Do not get eaten. I am not training a replacement.
assets.spoken_text: Uh. The jaws are moving. It is eating the field. Do not get eaten. I am not training a replacement.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Processing jaws are awake. It is pulling everything in. Including you, genius.
assets.spoken_text: Processing jaws are awake. It is pulling everything in. Including you, genius.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are in the jaws. Full thrust, or cut the load. Now.
assets.spoken_text: You are in the jaws. Full thrust, or cut the load. Now.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: It ate your cargo. That station owes us money now. Good luck collecting.
assets.spoken_text: It ate your cargo. That station owes us money now. Good luck collecting.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Heads up. Automated mining drones are still working the old Kessler contract. They cut rock and fling it everywhere. Like my ex.
assets.spoken_text: Heads up. Automated mining drones are still working the old Kessler contract. They cut rock and fling it everywhere. Like my ex.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Mining drones on scope. They do not care what is in the way. Their ore spills are free money, though.
assets.spoken_text: Mining drones on scope. They do not care what is in the way. Their ore spills are free money, though.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Debris storm by the miners. Those pebbles are moving fast.
assets.spoken_text: Debris storm by the miners. Those pebbles are moving fast.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are in their blast zone. Fast rock incoming. Duck. Figuratively.
assets.spoken_text: You are in their blast zone. Fast rock incoming. Duck. Figuratively.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You shot a miner. Now it is drilling you. Shocking.
assets.spoken_text: You shot a miner. Now it is drilling you. Shocking.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That miner is pointing its cutter at you. Back off, or finish the job.
assets.spoken_text: That miner is pointing its cutter at you. Back off, or finish the job.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Miner down. Its ore hopper just burst open.
assets.spoken_text: Miner down. Its ore hopper just burst open.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Scrapped a miner. Grab the ore before somebody else does.
assets.spoken_text: Scrapped a miner. Grab the ore before somebody else does.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Debt collector on scope. They do not want the cargo. They want the tug.
assets.spoken_text: Debt collector on scope. They do not want the cargo. They want the tug.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Kessler Mutual Recovery is here. And our payment is not even late. Yet.
assets.spoken_text: Kessler Mutual Recovery is here. And our payment is not even late. Yet.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are netted. Hard left, hard right, tear it. Or shoot that thing.
assets.spoken_text: You are netted. Hard left, hard right, tear it. Or shoot that thing.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: They got a net on you. Wiggle out before they tow you off the field.
assets.spoken_text: They got a net on you. Wiggle out before they tow you off the field.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Net is torn. Now get away from that man.
assets.spoken_text: Net is torn. Now get away from that man.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are loose. Do not let them line up another shot, sugar.
assets.spoken_text: You are loose. Do not let them line up another shot, sugar.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Collector down. Legally, I never saw that.
assets.spoken_text: Collector down. Legally, I never saw that.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Scrapped a repo man. That plating is worth something. Unlike him.
assets.spoken_text: Scrapped a repo man. That plating is worth something. Unlike him.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That collector just went greedy. They are not here for your payment anymore. They want your haul.
assets.spoken_text: That collector just went greedy. They are not here for your payment anymore. They want your haul.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Collector is leaving. Your numbers check out, for once.
assets.spoken_text: Collector is leaving. Your numbers check out, for once.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: They are almost at the edge with you. Break free. Now.
assets.spoken_text: They are almost at the edge with you. Break free. Now.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That is a fat cable. Kessler Mutual noticed. Collector inbound, and they will take the load if they catch you.
assets.spoken_text: That is a fat cable. Kessler Mutual noticed. Collector inbound, and they will take the load if they catch you.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are hauling a fortune, and the bank can smell it. Collector on the way. Get it home.
assets.spoken_text: You are hauling a fortune, and the bank can smell it. Collector on the way. Get it home.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Drone down. Kessler Security can send me the bill. I will lose it.
assets.spoken_text: Drone down. Kessler Security can send me the bill. I will lose it.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You keep scrapping their people. The rival crews are annoyed now. They will shoot while they steal.
assets.spoken_text: You keep scrapping their people. The rival crews are annoyed now. They will shoot while they steal.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: The rival crews have a grudge, kiddo. Some of them are coming for you now, not the cargo.
assets.spoken_text: The rival crews have a grudge, kiddo. Some of them are coming for you now, not the cargo.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Congratulations. It is a vendetta. They hunt in pairs now. I am updating your obituary.
assets.spoken_text: Congratulations. It is a vendetta. They hunt in pairs now. I am updating your obituary.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Rival inbound, and that one is not here for cargo. It is here for you.
assets.spoken_text: Rival inbound, and that one is not here for cargo. It is here for you.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Hunter on scope. Somebody holds a grudge, hotshot.
assets.spoken_text: Hunter on scope. Somebody holds a grudge, hotshot.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Another collector? Your wanted level just went up again. The sheriff reads the same reports I do.
assets.spoken_text: Another collector? Your wanted level just went up again. The sheriff reads the same reports I do.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Sheriff patrol in the field. Keep your nose clean, for once.
assets.spoken_text: Sheriff patrol in the field. Keep your nose clean, for once.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Sheriff patrol inbound, and you are wanted. Keep your distance.
assets.spoken_text: Sheriff patrol inbound, and you are wanted. Keep your distance.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: The sheriff spotted you. Run, or get cuffed. Do not let him get close.
assets.spoken_text: The sheriff spotted you. Run, or get cuffed. Do not let him get close.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Lights and sirens, kiddo. He is on you. Keep moving.
assets.spoken_text: Lights and sirens, kiddo. He is on you. Keep moving.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You lost him. For now. He will be back, they always are.
assets.spoken_text: You lost him. For now. He will be back, they always are.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Watch your fire, hotshot. That is the sheriff. Hit him all you like, but if he goes down, you are wanted.
assets.spoken_text: Watch your fire, hotshot. That is the sheriff. Hit him all you like, but if he goes down, you are wanted.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: More law inbound. They are bringing friends.
assets.spoken_text: More law inbound. They are bringing friends.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Backup is on the way, and it is not yours.
assets.spoken_text: Backup is on the way, and it is not yours.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Five stars. That is the Galactic SWAT team. Live rounds, hotshot. Run. Very. Fast.
assets.spoken_text: Five stars. That is the Galactic SWAT team. Live rounds, hotshot. Run. Very. Fast.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: The sheriff is shaking you down. No warrant, no reason, he just wants your cargo. Run, or lose it.
assets.spoken_text: The sheriff is shaking you down. No warrant, no reason, he just wants your cargo. Run, or lose it.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You shot down the sheriff. Two more stars. I am not bailing you out.
assets.spoken_text: You shot down the sheriff. Two more stars. I am not bailing you out.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Shields are down. Hull is next, hotshot.
assets.spoken_text: Shields are down. Hull is next, hotshot.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: There go your shields. Try not getting hit. Novel idea.
assets.spoken_text: There go your shields. Try not getting hit. Novel idea.

assets.spoken_text: Missile rack is live. It shoots first and never asks.

assets.spoken_text: Heat sink is cooked. Guns and thrusters are locked until it cools. Like you should be.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You are overheating. Ease off the trigger, hotshot.
assets.spoken_text: You are overheating. Ease off the trigger, hotshot.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Ground it into slugs. Accounting just wept.
assets.spoken_text: Ground it into slugs. Accounting just wept.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Grinder fed. Sale value, zero. Ammo, plenty. I hate it here.
assets.spoken_text: Grinder fed. Sale value, zero. Ammo, plenty. I hate it here.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You put a reactor in the grinder? A reactor. In the grinder.
assets.spoken_text: You put a reactor in the grinder? A reactor. In the grinder.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Scoop caught something. Free money, probably.
assets.spoken_text: Scoop caught something. Free money, probably.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Jumper scrapped. Their parts spend like anybody else's.
assets.spoken_text: Jumper scrapped. Their parts spend like anybody else's.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: One less pink dot. Grab what fell off.
assets.spoken_text: One less pink dot. Grab what fell off.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: You hit him with an engine. That is going in the newsletter.
assets.spoken_text: You hit him with an engine. That is going in the newsletter.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Cargo-based diplomacy. I approve.
assets.spoken_text: Cargo-based diplomacy. I approve.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That was a reactor. Was. Past tense.
assets.spoken_text: That was a reactor. Was. Past tense.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Reactor blew. Count your fingers. Then count the cargo.
assets.spoken_text: Reactor blew. Count your fingers. Then count the cargo.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Cut loose. Your cargo, your call. Your mistake.
assets.spoken_text: Cut loose. Your cargo, your call. Your mistake.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: One minute left. Bring it home.
assets.spoken_text: One minute left. Bring it home.

assets.text: Ten seconds. Bay doors are closing.
assets.spoken_text: Ten seconds. Bay doors are closing.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: New derelict drifting into the field. Fresh pickings.
assets.spoken_text: New derelict drifting into the field. Fresh pickings.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Bay crew is patching you up. Hold still, you are not that interesting.
assets.spoken_text: Bay crew is patching you up. Hold still, you are not that interesting.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: That core is still angry. It will bite you every so often until it is in the bay.
assets.spoken_text: That core is still angry. It will bite you every so often until it is in the bay.

assets.text: You cooked the engine, hotshot. Six seconds of crawling while it cools. Ease off the burners.
assets.spoken_text: You cooked the engine, hotshot. Six seconds of crawling while it cools. Ease off the burners.

assets.text: You broke the jaws. Somebody at Kessler is going to cry about that. It won't be me.
assets.spoken_text: You broke the jaws. Somebody at Kessler is going to cry about that. It won't be me.

assets.text: Hauler is docked. Not a scratch on it. Well, a few scratches. Nobody is counting.
assets.spoken_text: Hauler is docked. Not a scratch on it. Well, a few scratches. Nobody is counting.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: The hauler is coming apart, hon. Get those crews off it.
assets.spoken_text: The hauler is coming apart, hon. Get those crews off it.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: We lost the hauler. That is going to be an awkward phone call.
assets.spoken_text: We lost the hauler. That is going to be an awkward phone call.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Ion storm has passed. Shields are coming back up. Slowly. Like everything else around here.
assets.spoken_text: Ion storm has passed. Shields are coming back up. Slowly. Like everything else around here.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Ion storm rolling through. Your shields are gone until it passes. Fly like you mean it.
assets.spoken_text: Ion storm rolling through. Your shields are gone until it passes. Fly like you mean it.

assets.text: Derelict freighter on scope. Hold full of salvage and nobody aboard. Every crew in the belt heard that too.
assets.spoken_text: Derelict freighter on scope. Hold full of salvage and nobody aboard. Every crew in the belt heard that too.

assets.spoken_text: Ha. Look at them run. Nobody wants to be next under that cargo.

assets.spoken_text: Hold is open. Ingots, an engine, maybe a reactor. Somebody locked that up for a reason. Take it anyway.

assets.spoken_text: That hold is sealed tight, hotshot. There is a keycard floating around out there. Tow it in.

assets.speaker: marge
assets.text: Carrier's private property, hotshot. The law can't touch you in here. Your record's clean. For now.
assets.spoken_text: Carrier's private property, hotshot. The law can't touch you in here. Your record's clean. For now.
